intent: Eight individual dimension tasks distinguish size, amount, length, speed, time order, vertical objects and reach relative to a person.
picturePurpose: Original paired complete bowls use identical teaspoons for common scale. The picture supports relative size only, without inventing volume or completed fruit packing. Coded queue length and movement remain independent and untimed.

transfer.stem: Which reading preserves quantity, speed and who can reach?
transfer.passage:
Helping at the park open day
Our class helped at a park open day beside the harbour. A large crowd gathered near the entrance. The queue was long, but it moved surprisingly quickly after another gate opened. We did not measure its speed or count every visitor.
At our stall, we needed a big bowl for all the fruit. A small gap behind the table let a cable pass through; we did not need to remove the wall. In the garden, our teacher said that a little rain would help the seedlings. That was a prediction, not a report that rain had already fallen.
Before the final task, we took a short break. Later, I wanted a box from a shelf, but it was too high for me to reach. An adult reached the box for me; my difficulty did not mean that nobody could reach it. Near the animal area, a tall gate kept the deer out of the garden. We recorded what happened that day without claiming that every tall gate would keep every animal out forever.

options.text: A long queue can move quickly; a little rain means some rain; a shelf too high for one person may still be reached by someone else.
Every long queue must move slowly; a little rain means some rain; a shelf too high for one person may still be reached by someone else.
A long queue can move quickly; a little rain means no rain at all; a shelf too high for one person may still be reached by someone else.
A long queue can move quickly; a little rain means some rain; nobody in the world can reach the shelf.

answer.display: A long queue can move quickly; a little rain means some rain; a shelf too high for one person may still be reached by someone else.
